title: Visual Project Map — Component Architecture
description: Component architecture of the Visual Project Map tool. Three phases: specification (design principles and schema defining what the tool should do), generation (AI skill that produces graph JSON from projects or objectives), and rendering (browser-based interactive DAG viewer). Data flows from declarative specs through AI-driven generation to interactive browser rendering.
_objective: Build a browser-based interactive DAG viewer for directed acyclic graphs with collapsible module groups, distributed as a Claude Code plugin. The tool must map existing projects (Input A) and design workflows from objectives (Input B), producing graph JSON rendered by a Cytoscape.js viewer with progressive disclosure, confidence encoding, and human-review checkpoint flags.

modules.label: Specification
modules.description: Declarative layer defining what the tool should do: design principles, feature requirements, graph constraints, and the JSON schema that all graphs must conform to.

modules.label: Design Principles & Features
modules.description: The 11 design principles (SPEC.md), feature catalog with status tracking (spec/features.md), and invariant graph properties (spec/graph-properties.md).

inputs.name: product_vision
inputs.description: High-level objectives and user needs for the tool

outputs.name: requirements
outputs.description: Design principles, feature specs, and structural constraints

modules.label: Graph Schema
modules.description: JSON Schema (schema.json) defining the valid structure of graph data: modules, nodes, edges, legend, and all optional fields (confidence, status, role, interface, description).

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Design principles and feature specs defining what fields the schema must support

modules.label: Generation
modules.description: AI-driven graph creation: foundation reference tables inform the generation skill, which scans projects or designs workflows to produce valid graph JSON.

modules.label: Foundation Tables
modules.description: Reference tables consumed by the generation skill: inference rules (module/node/edge detection heuristics), color palette (12 module + 4 phase colors), and graph schema quick reference.

inputs.name: schema_json
inputs.description: Schema definitions to document for skill consumption

outputs.name: lookup_tables
outputs.description: Inference rules, color assignments, and schema field reference

modules.label: Generation Skill
modules.checkpointReason: The skill orchestrates complex AI reasoning across 3 phases — design decisions about module boundaries, confidence assessment, and CLAUDE.md scaffolding require human review of the generated output
modules.description: SKILL.md instructions that guide Claude through discovery (Input A) or design (Input B), graph construction, validation, and output. Produces graph JSON conforming to schema.json.

inputs.name: user_input
inputs.description: Directory path (Input A), objective text (Input B), or existing JSON (Input C) with optional flags

outputs.name: graph_json
outputs.description: Valid graph JSON with modules, nodes, edges, and metadata

modules.label: Rendering
modules.description: Browser-based interactive visualization: loads graph JSON, renders via Cytoscape.js with dagre layout, manages collapse state, handles user interaction, and provides extended view modes.

modules.label: Viewer Core
modules.description: Core rendering engine (viewer.js + index.html): fetches graph JSON, validates structure, converts to Cytoscape elements, applies visual styles from graph data, and runs dagre hierarchical layout.

inputs.name: graph_json
inputs.description: Graph JSON loaded via ?graph= URL parameter

outputs.name: cy_instance
outputs.description: Initialized Cytoscape instance with elements, styles, and layout

modules.label: Collapse Manager
modules.description: Custom expand/collapse engine (expand-collapse.js): removes children via cy.remove() to collapse, restores via cy.add() to expand, rebuilds deduplicated meta-edges for cross-module connections.

inputs.name: cy_instance
inputs.description: Cytoscape instance with all elements loaded

outputs.name: collapse_api
outputs.description: CollapseManager with toggle/collapseAll/expandAll methods and collapsed state

modules.label: User Interactions
modules.description: Event handling layer (interactions.js): click-to-toggle modules, hover tooltips and highlighting, keyboard shortcuts, search, toolbar buttons, node detail side panel, edge detail modal.

inputs.name: collapse_api
inputs.description: CollapseManager instance for toggling modules on click

outputs.name: ui_state
outputs.description: Active view mode, search state, panel visibility, path trace selection

modules.label: Extended Views
modules.checkpointReason: View modes (plan, diff, confidence) encode complex semantics — the visual encoding choices and V-key cycling order require UX review
modules.description: Augmented view modes: plan overlay (plan-overlay.js) with add/modify/remove glow, diff view (diff.js) comparing graph versions, minimap (minimap.js) for navigation, and watch mode for auto-refresh.

inputs.name: ui_state
inputs.description: Active view mode selection from interactions module

outputs.name: augmented_view
outputs.description: Modified Cytoscape styles and canvas overlays for the active view mode

nodes.label: principles.design_principles
nodes.description: Eleven principles governing tool design: interfaces as primary content, progressive disclosure, confidence encoding, CLAUDE.md per module, graphs embed folder hierarchy and reveal logical flow, 1-edge-per-module-pair at every hierarchy level, and design-mode applicability table.

nodes.label: principles.feature_catalog
nodes.description: Feature catalog (F01–F76) tracking every viewer and skill feature with implementation status, file locations, and property cross-references.

nodes.label: principles.graph_properties
nodes.description: Invariant properties every rendered graph must satisfy: structural validity, visual encoding rules, layout constraints, interaction behaviors.

nodes.label: schema.type_definitions
nodes.description: Required top-level fields (title, modules, nodes, edges) and their object structures with required vs optional fields.

nodes.label: schema.optional_fields
nodes.description: Extended schema fields: confidence, status, role, interface, description, criticalPath (node ID array), module.docPath, generation metadata (_generationMode, _objective, _generatedAt).

nodes.label: schema.visual_encoding
nodes.description: How schema fields map to visual properties: role→shape, status→opacity+border, confidence→border treatment, trust→border style.

nodes.label: foundations.inference_rules
nodes.description: Module detection heuristics, node shape assignment, edge style rules, actor inference, status/role/confidence lookup tables, and 9 module design principles.

nodes.label: foundations.color_palette
nodes.description: 12 module background/border color pairs, 4 phase colors, terminal color overrides, and assignment rules (directory order, slate for terminals).

nodes.label: foundations.schema_reference
nodes.description: Quick reference documenting all graph schema fields, role/status/confidence visual encoding tables — the skill's cheat sheet during generation.

nodes.label: skill.parse_arguments
nodes.description: Parse input type from CLI arguments: directory path triggers Input A (scan), --objective triggers Input B (design), JSON path triggers Input C (direct load).

nodes.label: skill.discover_or_design
nodes.description: Phase 1: scan codebase for CLAUDE.md, scripts, I/O patterns, folder structure. Phase 1B: decompose objective into stages, define data flow, assess confidence.

nodes.label: skill.construct_graph
nodes.description: Phase 2: define modules (top-down from structure), nodes (from steps), edges (from flow). Enforce 1-edge rule. Apply colors, shapes, status, confidence.

nodes.label: skill.write_and_serve
nodes.description: Phase 3: validate graph, write .graphs/*.json, launch serve.py, suggest CLAUDE.md scaffolding (design mode). Support incremental regeneration.

nodes.label: viewer.load_graph
nodes.description: Fetch graph JSON via ?graph= URL parameter, run runtime validation (required fields, duplicate IDs, dangling references, circular parents), show error panel on failure.

nodes.label: viewer.build_elements
nodes.description: Convert modules → compound nodes, nodes → child nodes, edges → edge elements. Pass through all data attributes (description, files, interface, status, role, confidence).

nodes.label: viewer.build_styles
nodes.description: Generate Cytoscape stylesheet from graph data: module colors, node shapes (role→hexagon, decision→diamond), borders (trust, status), edge colors (actor), opacity (status).

nodes.label: viewer.run_layout
nodes.description: Dagre hierarchical layout with longest-path ranker, configurable spacing. Falls back to network-simplex on error. Fits viewport after layout.

nodes.label: collapse.initialize
nodes.description: CollapseManager constructor: store all original edges, initialize collapsed state tracking, call collapseAll() for default collapsed view.

nodes.label: collapse.toggle_module
nodes.description: Collapse: cy.remove() children and internal edges. Expand: cy.add() stored children and edges. Depth-aware for nested phases (deepest first collapse, shallowest first expand).

nodes.label: collapse.rebuild_meta_edges
nodes.description: When modules are collapsed, rebuild cross-module edges as deduplicated meta-edges with combined labels and propagated actor colors.

nodes.label: interactions.click_handlers
nodes.description: Click module → toggle expand/collapse. Click node → open side panel (description, I/O, files) or path trace. Click edge → open detail modal (script, inputs, outputs). Shift+click → always path trace.

nodes.label: interactions.hover_effects
nodes.description: Hover node → tooltip with label, description preview, file indicators; dim non-neighbors. Hover edge → show label, script name, description. Clear on mouseout.

nodes.label: interactions.keyboard_shortcuts
nodes.description: F=fit, E=expand all, C=collapse all, L=toggle labels, V=cycle views, W=watch mode, M=minimap, P=critical path, /=search focus, Escape=clear.

nodes.label: interactions.detail_panels
nodes.description: Node detail side panel (left, non-blocking), edge detail modal (centered), plan summary panel (right slide-in), breadcrumb bar (top, shows drill-down path).

nodes.label: overlays.view_switcher
nodes.description: V key cycles through view modes: Module (default colors), Provenance (trust states), Actor (edge performer), Files (I/O paths), Confidence (module confidence coloring), Plan (annotations), Diff (version comparison). Context-sensitive legend updates per view.

nodes.label: overlays.plan_overlay
nodes.description: Plan view: green/amber/red glow on annotated elements (add/modify/remove). Collapsed modules show +N ~M -R badges. Plan summary panel shows goal and tasks.

nodes.label: overlays.diff_view
nodes.description: Diff view via ?compare= URL: compute structural diff (added/removed/modified) for modules, nodes, edges. Green/amber/red/dimmed overlay with summary counts.

nodes.label: overlays.minimap
nodes.description: Canvas-based overview inset in bottom-right corner. Shows all nodes/edges at thumbnail scale with viewport rectangle. Click to navigate. Toggle via M key.

edges.label: define schema
edges.description: Graph properties and design principles define the structural and visual constraints that the JSON schema must encode.

edges.label: document format
edges.description: Schema field definitions and visual encoding rules are documented in foundation reference tables for easy skill consumption during graph generation.

edges.label: inform generation
edges.description: Foundation tables (inference rules, colors, schema docs) are consulted throughout all phases of graph generation as the AI's reference material.

edges.label: render graph
edges.description: Skill writes validated graph JSON to .graphs/; serve.py copies it to the viewer's examples directory and opens the browser to render it.

edges.label: initialize collapse
edges.description: After dagre layout completes, CollapseManager initializes: stores original edges, collapses all modules, re-runs layout for the default collapsed view.

edges.label: handle events
edges.description: Collapse state determines which elements are visible; the interactions module attaches event handlers to the current Cytoscape elements.

edges.label: switch views
edges.description: View mode switcher (V key, toolbar buttons) in interactions triggers extended view modes in the overlays module: plan, diff, minimap.
